002.name: Rin
002.text:
What a big house! It's even bigger than 
			the noble houses in the village!

003.name: Rin
003.text: This garden is beautiful as well!

004.name: Rin
004.text:
I wonder what kind of people live here to
			have such things.

005.text: I heard you like the garden?

007.name: Rin
007.text: Yes that was me. Are you the groundskeeper.

009.text: Yes, this is my garden. Glad you like it.

010.name: Rin
010.text:
The flowers are very pretty, But do you really maintain this whole
			garden by yourself?

012.name: Meiling
012.text:
I take my role as gate guard very seriously. But since people rarely come,
			I have time to tend to the landscape.

013.name: Rin
013.text: Oh, so you are the gatekeeper?

014.name: Meiling
014.text: That is correct. You are at the gates of the Scarlet Devil Mansion.

015.name: Rin
015.text:
I'm sure you noticed this strange weather we're having. It
			appears to be coming from this place.

016.name: Meiling
016.text:
It does, but I know nothing of it;
			just to not let outsiders interfere with the lady.

017.name: Rin
017.text: Can I go inside? I really need to know what's going on in there.

018.name: Meiling
018.text: The instructions are clear, no one gets inside.

021.name: Meiling
021.text:
Sorry Miss, I can't let you inside.
			Why don't you stay in the garden instead.
